# Tripo API, Explained — AI + Tripo 3D asset pipeline

> A bilingual (zh/en) interactive site that explains the Tripo 3D generation API to non-engineers, and shows a real end-to-end run of an AI + Tripo + Blender asset pipeline.

API base: https://openapi.tripo3d.ai/v3

## Tripo API features
- Text-to-image · Image-to-image (POST /generation/text-to-image · POST /generation/image-to-image) [verified]: Make an image from a sentence, or edit, extract or restyle an existing one. Tripo puts several image models behind one API.
- Image-to-3D · Text-to-3D (POST /generation/image-to-model · POST /generation/text-to-model) [verified]: Turns an image (or a sentence) into a textured 3D model. The key choice is the model family: H for detail, P for clean low-poly.
- Gaussian splat (POST /generation/image-to-splat) [documented]: Turns one image into a .splat made of countless soft translucent points: photoreal-looking, but not a mesh, so it can’t be edited or used as game geometry directly.
- Texture & PBR (texture / pbr · POST /models/texture) [verified]: The same model can come bare, with base colour, or with full PBR (roughness, metalness, normals) so it reacts to light realistically.
- Multiview to 3D (POST /generation/image-to-multiview · POST /generation/multiview-to-model) [documented]: Generate front/left/back/right views from one image (or use your own photos), then build from multiple views for a more faithful model.
- Part segmentation (POST /mesh/segment · POST /mesh/complete · generate_parts) [documented]: Split one model into parts; hidden surfaces revealed by the split can be filled with the completion endpoint. Or ask for parts during generation.
- Retopology & UV (POST /mesh/decimate · POST /mesh/uv) [documented]: Reduce a dense model to a target face count with clean triangles or quads; Smart UV re-unwraps texture coordinates and carries textures and rigs across.
- Rig & animate (POST /animations/rig-check · /animations/rig · /animations/retarget) [documented]: Check for free whether a model can be rigged, auto-rig it, then apply preset motions like walk, run or jump.
- Stylize (POST /models/stylize) [unconfirmed]: Converts a model into styles like brick or voxel. The V3 docs list this endpoint only in the migration table with no parameter page, so this is a concept demo.
- Convert & export (POST /models/convert) [documented]: Converts a model for each tool and tidies it: decimate, quads, pivot to bottom-centre, scale, texture size.
- How a task runs (POST /files · GET /tasks/{task_id}) [verified]: Every generation is an async task: submit, get a task_id, poll, download soon after success.

## Pipeline modules
- [Brief & Order](docs/modules/order-brief.md) [create, live]: Turns a one-line request into an asset list in a single order JSON: objects, style, references, real-world size, face budget, targets and budget. Every downstream step follows the order.
- [Concept Art & Sign-off](docs/modules/concept-art.md) [create, live]: Tripo text-to-image makes a whole-scene concept to lock style and lighting; after human sign-off, image-to-image extracts a reference per prop from that concept so every asset shares one style. Aligning in 2D is far cheaper than iterating in 3D.
- [Tripo Image-to-3D](docs/modules/tripo-generate.md) [generate, live]: Calls the Tripo API with a prop reference to produce a model with PBR textures. Best for characters, creatures, organic shapes and complex hero props.
- [Procedural Geometry](docs/modules/procedural-geometry.md) [generate, live]: Tables, bases, belts and repeated parts are generated in code: precise, tweakable and free.
- [Structural QA](docs/modules/structure-qa.md) [process, live]: Read-only checks on the raw glb: meshes, triangle count, UVs, materials and textures. A structural report does not replace art or Blender checks.
- [Blender Cleanup & Assembly](docs/modules/blender-cleanup.md) [process, live]: Headless Blender scripts normalise real-world scale, move pivots to the base, recalculate normals, decimate over budget, assemble the scene from the plan, then export and re-import to verify.
- [Four-View Critic](docs/modules/visual-critic.md) [process, live]: Renders overview, close-up, low-angle and wireframe views; an independent critic lists at least three concrete flaws and scores the scene, routing failures back to the right step.
- [Asset Library](docs/modules/asset-library.md) [library, live]: Every asset is stored as glb plus meta.json with source, order, size, triangle count and QA results. Downstream scenes only take from here.
- [Blender Showcase](docs/modules/blender-showcase.md) [apps, live]: Lighting, cameras and turntables are script templates: drop an asset in, get stills and video out.
- [Web three.js](docs/modules/web-threejs.md) [apps, live]: Loads glb directly in the browser. The site you are looking at is this module's output.
- [Unreal Engine Scene](docs/modules/ue-scene.md) [apps, planned]: Builds Unreal scenes from library assets via Epic's Unreal MCP.
- [TouchDesigner FX](docs/modules/td-fx.md) [apps, planned]: Brings assets into real-time visuals via TouchDesigner MCP.
- [Promo Video](docs/modules/promo-video.md) [apps, planned]: Astra writes the script and storyboard; Seedance generates a promo clip referencing the showcase renders.
- [Ambient Audio](docs/modules/ambient-audio.md) [apps, planned]: ElevenLabs generates ambience and sound effects for showcase videos and web scenes.
